classification: Backward-compatible clarification of the general legacy v1-v4 snapshot scope
receiptImpact: No signed receipt, attestation, semantic profile, registry release, partner policy or historical promotion bytes change. The general legacy snapshot-relative verification contract covers v1-v4. The narrower v2-v4 wording in promotions v5 and v6 described the VERITAS workflow only and did not supersede the repository-wide v1-v4 rule.
activationRule: Historical v1-v4 receipts remain verification-only and must be evaluated against their exact receipt-adjacent registry bytes, with the full SHA-256 and byte length preserved and checked. A missing or mismatched snapshot fails closed, no legacy verdict is globally canonical, and production signing remains v5-only. Existing partner policy ids and activation mappings remain unchanged.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: The v5-only production policy, receipt schema, semantic profile, registry release floor and activation mapping are unchanged.

The VERITAS workflow remains production-disabled and snapshot-relative; this promotion clarifies that the repository-wide legacy contract includes v1 as well as v2-v4, without changing historical bytes or admission rules.

The frozen external-evidence/v0 rev6 adapter, pinned OracleSafetyCheck v2 carrier and production-disabled policy are unchanged.
OracleSafetyCheck v2, pre-trade envelope bytes, signer trust rules and activation mapping are unchanged.
OracleSafetyCheck v3 layout, registry key material, signer roles and activation mapping are unchanged.
